readings_chosen: Sentence 1: ‘drew ... back’ could mean a literal physical pull or figurative attraction. I take the wording as an asserted drawing of the visitor back without committing to the literal-pull mechanics. Because this reading is not settled by an explicit clarification, the entire drawing line is filled in. The unchanged draw verb and drew_back description preserve the source wording; no pull shape, desire, intention, tendency or mechanism is supplied. Both readings and the image are retained in the bin.

Sentence 1: ‘back’ indicates a return but gives no reference place for toward X or away from X. I leave the machine direction not_stated, which denotes an absent slot rather than a new direction. The back wording survives in the description and the bin; the spatial relation is not computed.

Sentence 1: ‘that is why the visitor returned’ can in other contexts introduce evidence, but here it picks up what drew the visitor back as the producer of the return. I use BECAUSE, with return and drawing as its endpoints, not SINCE. The causal claim is explicit; its stated cause nevertheless depends on the marked reading of drawing.

Sentence 1: ‘burning’ is GIVEN by the noun phrase; drawing and return are asserted. ‘Returned’ has no object, so it is retained as an eventive Fact. No different visitor, prior non-return, separate stage change, general causal bridge or stated tendency is added.
